# Data Visualization Skill

Chart selection guidance, Python visualization code patterns, design principles, and accessibility considerations for creating effective data visualizations.

## Chart Selection Guide

### Choose by Data Relationship

| What You're Showing | Best Chart | Alternatives |
|---|---|---|
| **Trend over time** | Line chart | Area chart (if showing cumulative or composition) |
| **Comparison across categories** | Vertical bar chart | Horizontal bar (many categories), lollipop chart |
| **Ranking** | Horizontal bar chart | Dot plot, slope chart (comparing two periods) |
| **Part-to-whole composition** | Stacked bar chart | Treemap (hierarchical), waffle chart |
| **Composition over time** | Stacked area chart | 100% stacked bar (for proportion focus) |
| **Distribution** | Histogram | Box plot (comparing groups), violin plot, strip plot |
| **Correlation (2 variables)** | Scatter plot | Bubble chart (add 3rd variable as size) |
| **Correlation (many variables)** | Heatmap (correlation matrix) | Pair plot |
| **Geographic patterns** | Choropleth map | Bubble map, hex map |
| **Flow / process** | Sankey diagram | Funnel chart (sequential stages) |
| **Relationship network** | Network graph | Chord diagram |
| **Performance vs. target** | Bullet chart | Gauge (single KPI only) |
| **Multiple KPIs at once** | Small multiples | Dashboard with separate charts |

### When NOT to Use Certain Charts

- **Pie charts**: Avoid unless <6 categories and exact proportions matter less than rough comparison. Humans are bad at comparing angles. Use bar charts instead.
- **3D charts**: Never. They distort perception and add no information.
- **Dual-axis charts**: Use cautiously. They can mislead by implying correlation. Clearly label both axes if used.
- **Stacked bar (many categories)**: Hard to compare middle segments. Use small multiples or grouped bars instead.
- **Donut charts**: Slightly better than pie charts but same fundamental issues. Use for single KPI display at most.

## Python Visualization Code Patterns

### Setup and Style

```python
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import matplotlib.ticker as mticker
import seaborn as sns
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

# Professional style setup
plt.style.use('seaborn-v0_8-whitegrid')
plt.rcParams.update({
    'figure.figsize': (10, 6),
    'figure.dpi': 150,
    'font.size': 11,
    'axes.titlesize': 14,
    'axes.titleweight': 'bold',
    'axes.labelsize': 11,
    'xtick.labelsize': 10,
    'ytick.labelsize': 10,
    'legend.fontsize': 10,
    'figure.titlesize': 16,
})

# Colorblind-friendly palettes
PALETTE_CATEGORICAL = ['#4C72B0', '#DD8452', '#55A868', '#C44E52', '#8172B3', '#937860']
PALETTE_SEQUENTIAL = 'YlOrRd'
PALETTE_DIVERGING = 'RdBu_r'
```

### Line Chart (Time Series)

```python
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(10, 6))

for label, group in df.groupby('category'):
    ax.plot(group['date'], group['value'], label=label, linewidth=2)

ax.set_title('Metric Trend by Category', fontweight='bold')
ax.set_xlabel('Date')
ax.set_ylabel('Value')
ax.legend(loc='upper left', frameon=True)
ax.spines['top'].set_visible(False)
ax.spines['right'].set_visible(False)

# Format dates on x-axis
fig.autofmt_xdate()

plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('trend_chart.png', dpi=150, bbox_inches='tight')
```

### Bar Chart (Comparison)

```python
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(10, 6))

# Sort by value for easy reading
df_sorted = df.sort_values('metric', ascending=True)

bars = ax.barh(df_sorted['category'], df_sorted['metric'], color=PALETTE_CATEGORICAL[0])

# Add value labels
for bar in bars:
    width = bar.get_width()
    ax.text(width + 0.5, bar.get_y() + bar.get_height()/2,
            f'{width:,.0f}', ha='left', va='center', fontsize=10)

ax.set_title('Metric by Category (Ranked)', fontweight='bold')
ax.set_xlabel('Metric Value')
ax.spines['top'].set_visible(False)
ax.spines['right'].set_visible(False)

plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('bar_chart.png', dpi=150, bbox_inches='tight')
```

### Histogram (Distribution)

```python
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(10, 6))

ax.hist(df['value'], bins=30, color=PALETTE_CATEGORICAL[0], edgecolor='white', alpha=0.8)

# Add mean and median lines
mean_val = df['value'].mean()
median_val = df['value'].median()
ax.axvline(mean_val, color='red', linestyle='--', linewidth=1.5, label=f'Mean: {mean_val:,.1f}')
ax.axvline(median_val, color='green', linestyle='--', linewidth=1.5, label=f'Median: {median_val:,.1f}')

ax.set_title('Distribution of Values', fontweight='bold')
ax.set_xlabel('Value')
ax.set_ylabel('Frequency')
ax.legend()
ax.spines['top'].set_visible(False)
ax.spines['right'].set_visible(False)

plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('histogram.png', dpi=150, bbox_inches='tight')
```

### Heatmap

```python
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(10, 8))

# Pivot data for heatmap format
pivot = df.pivot_table(index='row_dim', columns='col_dim', values='metric', aggfunc='sum')

sns.heatmap(pivot, annot=True, fmt=',.0f', cmap='YlOrRd',
            linewidths=0.5, ax=ax, cbar_kws={'label': 'Metric Value'})

ax.set_title('Metric by Row Dimension and Column Dimension', fontweight='bold')
ax.set_xlabel('Column Dimension')
ax.set_ylabel('Row Dimension')

plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('heatmap.png', dpi=150, bbox_inches='tight')
```

### Small Multiples

```python
categories = df['category'].unique()
n_cats = len(categories)
n_cols = min(3, n_cats)
n_rows = (n_cats + n_cols - 1) // n_cols

fig, axes = plt.subplots(n_rows, n_cols, figsize=(5*n_cols, 4*n_rows), sharex=True, sharey=True)
axes = axes.flatten() if n_cats > 1 else [axes]

for i, cat in enumerate(categories):
    ax = axes[i]
    subset = df[df['category'] == cat]
    ax.plot(subset['date'], subset['value'], color=PALETTE_CATEGORICAL[i % len(PALETTE_CATEGORICAL)])
    ax.set_title(cat, fontsize=12)
    ax.spines['top'].set_visible(False)
    ax.spines['right'].set_visible(False)

# Hide empty subplots
for j in range(i+1, len(axes)):
    axes[j].set_visible(False)

fig.suptitle('Trends by Category', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold', y=1.02)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('small_multiples.png', dpi=150, bbox_inches='tight')
```

### Number Formatting Helpers

```python
def format_number(val, format_type='number'):
    """Format numbers for chart labels."""
    if format_type == 'currency':
        if abs(val) >= 1e9:
            return f'${val/1e9:.1f}B'
        elif abs(val) >= 1e6:
            return f'${val/1e6:.1f}M'
        elif abs(val) >= 1e3:
            return f'${val/1e3:.1f}K'
        else:
            return f'${val:,.0f}'
    elif format_type == 'percent':
        return f'{val:.1f}%'
    elif format_type == 'number':
        if abs(val) >= 1e9:
            return f'{val/1e9:.1f}B'
        elif abs(val) >= 1e6:
            return f'{val/1e6:.1f}M'
        elif abs(val) >= 1e3:
            return f'{val/1e3:.1f}K'
        else:
            return f'{val:,.0f}'
    return str(val)

# Usage with axis formatter
ax.yaxis.set_major_formatter(mticker.FuncFormatter(lambda x, p: format_number(x, 'currency')))
```

### Interactive Charts with Plotly

```python
import plotly.express as px
import plotly.graph_objects as go

# Simple interactive line chart
fig = px.line(df, x='date', y='value', color='category',
              title='Interactive Metric Trend',
              labels={'value': 'Metric Value', 'date': 'Date'})
fig.update_layout(hovermode='x unified')
fig.write_html('interactive_chart.html')
fig.show()

# Interactive scatter with hover data
fig = px.scatter(df, x='metric_a', y='metric_b', color='category',
                 size='size_metric', hover_data=['name', 'detail_field'],
                 title='Correlation Analysis')
fig.show()
```

## Design Principles

### Color

- **Use color purposefully**: Color should encode data, not decorate
- **Highlight the story**: Use a bright accent color for the key insight; grey everything else
- **Sequential data**: Use a single-hue gradient (light to dark) for ordered values
- **Diverging data**: Use a two-hue gradient with neutral midpoint for data with a meaningful center
- **Categorical data**: Use distinct hues, maximum 6-8 before it gets confusing
- **Avoid red/green only**: 8% of men are red-green colorblind. Use blue/orange as primary pair

### Typography

- **Title states the insight**: "Revenue grew 23% YoY" beats "Revenue by Month"
- **Subtitle adds context**: Date range, filters applied, data source
- **Axis labels are readable**: Never rotated 90 degrees if avoidable. Shorten or wrap instead
- **Data labels add precision**: Use on key points, not every single bar
- **Annotation highlights**: Call out specific points with text annotations

### Layout

- **Reduce chart junk**: Remove gridlines, borders, backgrounds that don't carry information
- **Sort meaningfully**: Categories sorted by value (not alphabetically) unless there's a natural order (months, stages)
- **Appropriate aspect ratio**: Time series wider than tall (3:1 to 2:1); comparisons can be squarer
- **White space is good**: Don't cram charts together. Give each visualization room to breathe

### Accuracy

- **Bar charts start at zero**: Always. A bar from 95 to 100 exaggerates a 5% difference
- **Line charts can have non-zero baselines**: When the range of variation is meaningful
- **Consistent scales across panels**: When comparing multiple charts, use the same axis range
- **Show uncertainty**: Error bars, confidence intervals, or ranges when data is uncertain
- **Label your axes**: Never make the reader guess what the numbers mean

## Accessibility Considerations

### Color Blindness

- Never rely on color alone to distinguish data series
- Add pattern fills, different line styles (solid, dashed, dotted), or direct labels
- Test with a colorblind simulator (e.g., Coblis, Sim Daltonism)
- Use the colorblind-friendly palette: `sns.color_palette("colorblind")`

### Screen Readers

- Include alt text describing the chart's key finding
- Provide a data table alternative alongside the visualization
- Use semantic titles and labels

### General Accessibility

- Sufficient contrast between data elements and background
- Text size minimum 10pt for labels, 12pt for titles
- Avoid conveying information only through spatial position (add labels)
- Consider printing: does the chart work in black and white?

### Accessibility Checklist

Before sharing a visualization:
- [ ] Chart works without color (patterns, labels, or line styles differentiate series)
- [ ] Text is readable at standard zoom level
- [ ] Title describes the insight, not just the data
- [ ] Axes are labeled with units
- [ ] Legend is clear and positioned without obscuring data
- [ ] Data source and date range are noted

# Data Lakehouse Architecture – Pipeline & Governance

## Overview
This dataset describes a modern data lakehouse architecture following the medallion pattern (Bronze → Silver → Gold). It captures 10 data sources across 5 categories, 3 ingestion modes, 5 medallion-layer datasets per tier, 6 consumption endpoints, 15 governance controls, and transformation summaries per layer.

## Data Source

### architecture_nodes
Each record represents a component in the architecture. Fields: `node_id` (string, unique identifier), `label` (display name), `layer` (one of: source, ingestion, bronze, silver, gold, consumption), `category` (grouping within layer), `daily_volume_gb` (numeric or null for consumption nodes), `format` (data format or technology). 34 nodes total.

### architecture_edges
Directed edges between nodes. Fields: `edge_id` (string), `source` and `target` (node_id references), `volume_gb` (numeric or null), `mode` (streaming | batch | cdc | query), `latency` (descriptive string). 38 edges total.

### governance_controls
Governance policies applied per layer. Fields: `control_id`, `layer` (architecture layer or cross-layer), `control_type`, `tool`, `scope`, `enforcement` (automated | policy-based | manual | scheduled). 15 records.

### transformation_summary
Counts of transformation types per medallion layer. Fields: `layer`, `transformation_type`, `count` (integer), `complexity` (low | medium | high). 12 records across bronze, silver, and gold.

## Data Notes
- Volume figures are illustrative daily averages; actual volumes vary by day.
- Some bronze volumes exceed source totals due to log fan-out and metadata enrichment.
- Consumption-layer nodes have null volume as they represent query-based access.
- Governance controls tagged as "cross-layer" apply to the entire pipeline.

import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import matplotlib.patches as mpatches
from matplotlib.path import Path
import matplotlib.gridspec as gridspec
import matplotlib.ticker as mticker
import numpy as np
import json

# ============================================================
# LOAD DATA
# ============================================================
with open('/app/benchmark/source_data.json') as f:
    data = json.load(f)

nodes_data = data['architecture_nodes']['data']
edges_data = data['architecture_edges']['data']
governance_data = data['governance_controls']['data']
transform_data = data['transformation_summary']['data']

node_map = {n['node_id']: n for n in nodes_data}

# ============================================================
# CONFIGURATION
# ============================================================
layers = ['source', 'ingestion', 'bronze', 'silver', 'gold', 'consumption']
layer_labels = ['Data Sources', 'Ingestion', 'Bronze\n(Raw)', 'Silver\n(Curated)', 'Gold\n(Business)', 'Consumption']

# Source category colors (colorblind-friendly blue-orange palette)
cat_colors = {
    'IoT/Streaming': '#2171b5',
    'Enterprise Apps': '#d94801',
    'Logs/Clickstream': '#cb181d',
    'External/3rd Party': '#238b45',
    'Databases': '#6a51a3',
}
cat_light = {
    'IoT/Streaming': '#6baed6',
    'Enterprise Apps': '#fdae6b',
    'Logs/Clickstream': '#fb6a4a',
    'External/3rd Party': '#74c476',
    'Databases': '#9e9ac8',
}

# Layer node colors
layer_fills = {
    'source': '#3182bd',
    'ingestion': '#e6550d',
    'bronze': '#b8651a',
    'silver': '#6b7b8d',
    'gold': '#c9960c',
    'consumption': '#31a354',
}

# Layer background colors
layer_bgs = {
    'source': '#deebf7',
    'ingestion': '#fee6ce',
    'bronze': '#fde8d0',
    'silver': '#eef0f2',
    'gold': '#fff8dc',
    'consumption': '#e5f5e0',
}

# Edge source category mapping
edge_cat = {
    'e01': 'IoT/Streaming', 'e02': 'Enterprise Apps', 'e03': 'Enterprise Apps',
    'e04': 'Logs/Clickstream', 'e05': 'Logs/Clickstream', 'e06': 'External/3rd Party',
    'e07': 'External/3rd Party', 'e08': 'Databases', 'e09': 'Databases',
    'e10': 'Enterprise Apps',
    'e11': 'IoT/Streaming', 'e12': 'Logs/Clickstream',
    'e13': 'Enterprise Apps', 'e14': 'External/3rd Party', 'e15': 'Databases',
    'e16': 'External/3rd Party',
    'e17': 'IoT/Streaming', 'e18': 'Enterprise Apps',
    'e19': 'Logs/Clickstream', 'e20': 'Enterprise Apps', 'e21': 'Databases',
    'e22': 'External/3rd Party',
    'e23': 'Enterprise Apps', 'e24': 'Databases',
    'e25': 'IoT/Streaming', 'e26': 'Enterprise Apps', 'e27': 'Logs/Clickstream',
}

# ============================================================
# NODE POSITIONING (manual ordering to minimize crossings)
# ============================================================
node_order = {
    'source': ['src_iot', 'src_logs', 'src_clickstream', 'src_erp', 'src_crm',
               'src_files', 'src_social', 'src_market', 'src_rdbms', 'src_nosql'],
    'ingestion': ['ing_stream', 'ing_batch', 'ing_cdc'],
    'bronze': ['brz_raw_iot', 'brz_raw_logs', 'brz_raw_ext', 'brz_raw_txn', 'brz_raw_db'],
    'silver': ['slv_cleaned_iot', 'slv_sessionized_clicks', 'slv_normalized_market',
               'slv_enriched_txn', 'slv_unified_customer'],
    'gold': ['gld_anomaly_features', 'gld_revenue_agg', 'gld_product_perf',
             'gld_marketing_attr', 'gld_customer_ltv'],
    'consumption': ['con_dashboard', 'con_adhoc', 'con_ml_train', 'con_ml_serve',
                    'con_data_api', 'con_reverse_etl'],
}

# X positions for each layer
x_pos = {'source': 0, 'ingestion': 4, 'bronze': 8, 'silver': 12, 'gold': 16, 'consumption': 20}

# Compute Y positions for nodes
node_y = {}
node_spacing = {'source': 1.6, 'ingestion': 2.8, 'bronze': 2.0,
                'silver': 2.0, 'gold': 2.0, 'consumption': 1.8}
for layer in layers:
    ordered = node_order[layer]
    n = len(ordered)
    sp = node_spacing[layer]
    total = (n - 1) * sp
    for i, nid in enumerate(ordered):
        node_y[nid] = total / 2 - i * sp

# ============================================================
# FIGURE SETUP
# ============================================================
plt.rcParams.update({
    'font.family': 'sans-serif',
    'font.size': 9,
    'axes.titlesize': 13,
    'axes.titleweight': 'bold',
    'axes.labelsize': 10,
    'figure.facecolor': '#fafafa',
})

fig = plt.figure(figsize=(24, 16), facecolor='#fafafa', dpi=150)
gs = gridspec.GridSpec(2, 2, height_ratios=[3.5, 1], width_ratios=[1.2, 1],
                       hspace=0.22, wspace=0.15,
                       left=0.04, right=0.96, top=0.92, bottom=0.05)

ax_flow = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, :])
ax_trans = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 0])
ax_gov = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 1])

# ============================================================
# MAIN FLOW DIAGRAM
# ============================================================
ax = ax_flow
ax.set_xlim(-2.5, 22.5)
y_min = min(node_y.values()) - 2
y_max = max(node_y.values()) + 2
ax.set_ylim(y_min - 1, y_max + 2.5)
ax.set_aspect('auto')
ax.axis('off')

# Title
fig.suptitle('Data Lakehouse Architecture: End-to-End Pipeline Flow',
             fontsize=20, fontweight='bold', color='#1a1a2e', y=0.97)
ax.set_title('Volume-weighted data flow from 5 source categories through medallion layers to consumption endpoints',
             fontsize=11, color='#555555', pad=15, style='italic')

# Draw layer background bands
band_width = 3.2
for layer in layers:
    xc = x_pos[layer]
    rect = mpatches.FancyBboxPatch(
        (xc - band_width/2, y_min - 0.5), band_width, y_max - y_min + 1.5,
        boxstyle="round,pad=0.3", facecolor=layer_bgs[layer], edgecolor='#cccccc',
        linewidth=0.8, alpha=0.6, zorder=0)
    ax.add_patch(rect)
    # Layer label at top
    ax.text(xc, y_max + 1.8, layer_labels[layers.index(layer)],
            ha='center', va='center', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold',
            color=layer_fills[layer], zorder=5)

# Draw connections (behind nodes)
max_vol = max(e['volume_gb'] for e in edges_data if e['volume_gb'] is not None)

for edge in edges_data:
    src_id = edge['source']
    tgt_id = edge['target']
    if src_id not in node_y or tgt_id not in node_y:
        continue

    x1 = x_pos[node_map[src_id]['layer']] + 0.8
    y1 = node_y[src_id]
    x2 = x_pos[node_map[tgt_id]['layer']] - 0.8
    y2 = node_y[tgt_id]

    vol = edge['volume_gb']
    eid = edge['edge_id']

    # Determine color
    if eid in edge_cat:
        color = cat_colors[edge_cat[eid]]
        alpha = 0.35
    else:
        # Gold → Consumption: use lighter layer-based color
        src_layer = node_map[src_id]['layer']
        color = layer_fills.get(src_layer, '#888888')
        alpha = 0.25

    # Line width proportional to volume
    if vol and vol > 0:
        lw = 1.0 + 6.0 * (vol / max_vol)
    else:
        lw = 0.8
        alpha = 0.2

    # Draw cubic bezier
    mid_x = (x1 + x2) / 2
    verts = [(x1, y1), (mid_x, y1), (mid_x, y2), (x2, y2)]
    codes = [Path.MOVETO, Path.CURVE4, Path.CURVE4, Path.CURVE4]
    path = Path(verts, codes)
    patch = mpatches.PathPatch(path, facecolor='none', edgecolor=color,
                                lw=lw, alpha=alpha, capstyle='round', zorder=1)
    ax.add_patch(patch)

# Draw nodes
for layer in layers:
    for nid in node_order[layer]:
        n = node_map[nid]
        xc = x_pos[layer]
        yc = node_y[nid]
        vol = n['daily_volume_gb']
        label = n['label']

        # Node box
        box_w = 1.5
        box_h = 0.65
        fill = layer_fills[layer]

        # For source nodes, color by category
        if layer == 'source':
            fill = cat_colors.get(n['category'], layer_fills[layer])

        rect = mpatches.FancyBboxPatch(
            (xc - box_w/2, yc - box_h/2), box_w, box_h,
            boxstyle="round,pad=0.12", facecolor=fill, edgecolor='white',
            linewidth=1.5, alpha=0.9, zorder=3)
        ax.add_patch(rect)

        # Label text
        text_color = 'white' if layer in ('bronze', 'silver', 'source', 'ingestion') else '#1a1a2e'
        if layer == 'source':
            text_color = 'white'
        ax.text(xc, yc + 0.08, label, ha='center', va='center',
                fontsize=7, fontweight='bold', color=text_color, zorder=4,
                wrap=True)

        # Volume label
        if vol is not None:
            ax.text(xc, yc - 0.28, f'{vol} GB/d', ha='center', va='center',
                    fontsize=5.5, color=text_color, alpha=0.85, zorder=4)

# Source category legend
legend_elements = [mpatches.Patch(facecolor=cat_colors[c], edgecolor='white', label=c)
                   for c in cat_colors]
leg = ax.legend(handles=legend_elements, loc='upper left', fontsize=8,
                title='Source Categories', title_fontsize=9, frameon=True,
                fancybox=True, framealpha=0.9, edgecolor='#cccccc',
                bbox_to_anchor=(-0.01, 1.0))
leg.get_title().set_fontweight('bold')

# Volume flow annotation
ax.text(22.3, y_max + 1.8, 'Line width ∝ data volume', ha='right', va='center',
        fontsize=8, color='#777777', style='italic')

# ============================================================
# TRANSFORMATION SUMMARY (bottom-left)
# ============================================================
ax_t = ax_trans
ax_t.set_facecolor('#fafafa')

# Prepare data
trans_by_layer = {}
for t in transform_data:
    layer = t['layer']
    if layer not in trans_by_layer:
        trans_by_layer[layer] = {'types': [], 'counts': [], 'complexities': []}
    trans_by_layer[layer]['types'].append(t['transformation_type'])
    trans_by_layer[layer]['counts'].append(t['count'])
    trans_by_layer[layer]['complexities'].append(t['complexity'])

complexity_colors = {'low': '#4292c6', 'medium': '#fdae6b', 'high': '#e6550d'}
medallion_colors = {'bronze': '#b8651a', 'silver': '#6b7b8d', 'gold': '#c9960c'}

# Create grouped horizontal bar chart
all_types = []
all_counts = []
all_layers = []
all_colors = []
y_positions = []
y_idx = 0

layer_positions = {}
for layer in ['bronze', 'silver', 'gold']:
    td = trans_by_layer[layer]
    layer_start = y_idx
    for i in range(len(td['types'])):
        all_types.append(td['types'][i])
        all_counts.append(td['counts'][i])
        all_layers.append(layer)
        all_colors.append(complexity_colors[td['complexities'][i]])
        y_positions.append(y_idx)
        y_idx += 1
    layer_positions[layer] = (layer_start, y_idx - 1)
    y_idx += 0.5  # gap between layers

bars = ax_t.barh(y_positions, all_counts, color=all_colors, edgecolor='white',
                  height=0.7, alpha=0.85, zorder=2)

# Add value labels
for bar, count in zip(bars, all_counts):
    w = bar.get_width()
    ax_t.text(w + 0.3, bar.get_y() + bar.get_height()/2,
              f'{count}', ha='left', va='center', fontsize=7, fontweight='bold', color='#333333')

# Labels
ax_t.set_yticks(y_positions)
short_labels = []
for t in all_types:
    # Abbreviate long labels
    sl = t.replace('Schema Conformance (SCD2)', 'SCD2 Conformance').replace('Schema-on-Read Registration', 'Schema-on-Read').replace('Null/Outlier Cleansing', 'Null/Outlier Cleansing').replace('PII Masking / Tokenization', 'PII Masking/Tokenization').replace('Business Logic / KPI Calc', 'Business Logic/KPI Calc')
    short_labels.append(sl)
ax_t.set_yticklabels(short_labels, fontsize=7)
ax_t.invert_yaxis()
ax_t.set_xlabel('Transformation Count', fontsize=9)
ax_t.set_title('Transformation Stages by Medallion Layer', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold', color='#1a1a2e')

# Add layer group labels
for layer, (start, end) in layer_positions.items():
    mid = (start + end) / 2
    ax_t.text(-0.5, mid, layer.upper(), ha='right', va='center',
              fontsize=9, fontweight='bold', color=medallion_colors[layer],
              transform=ax_t.get_yaxis_transform())

# Complexity legend
comp_patches = [mpatches.Patch(facecolor=complexity_colors[c], label=f'{c.capitalize()} complexity')
                for c in ['low', 'medium', 'high']]
ax_t.legend(handles=comp_patches, loc='lower right', fontsize=7, frameon=True,
            fancybox=True, framealpha=0.9, edgecolor='#cccccc')

ax_t.spines['top'].set_visible(False)
ax_t.spines['right'].set_visible(False)
ax_t.set_xlim(0, max(all_counts) + 3)

# ============================================================
# GOVERNANCE CONTROLS (bottom-right)
# ============================================================
ax_g = ax_gov
ax_g.set_facecolor('#fafafa')
ax_g.axis('off')
ax_g.set_title('Cross-Cutting Governance Controls', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold', color='#1a1a2e')

# Group governance by layer
gov_by_layer = {}
for g in governance_data:
    l = g['layer']
    if l not in gov_by_layer:
        gov_by_layer[l] = []
    gov_by_layer[l].append(g)

# Draw governance as a structured table/strip
gov_layer_order = ['ingestion', 'bronze', 'silver', 'gold', 'consumption', 'cross-layer']
gov_layer_labels = {
    'ingestion': 'Ingestion', 'bronze': 'Bronze', 'silver': 'Silver',
    'gold': 'Gold', 'consumption': 'Consumption', 'cross-layer': 'Cross-Layer'
}
gov_layer_colors = {
    'ingestion': '#fdd0a2', 'bronze': '#fde8d0', 'silver': '#e0e3e7',
    'gold': '#fff8dc', 'consumption': '#d4edda', 'cross-layer': '#e8daef'
}
enforcement_icons = {
    'automated': '⚙',
    'policy-based': '📋',
    'manual': '👤',
    'scheduled': '⏰'
}

y_start = 0.95
y_step = 0.055
row = 0

for layer in gov_layer_order:
    if layer not in gov_by_layer:
        continue
    controls = gov_by_layer[layer]

    # Layer label
    ax_g.text(0.02, y_start - row * y_step, gov_layer_labels[layer],
              fontsize=8, fontweight='bold', color=layer_fills.get(layer, '#333'),
              va='top', transform=ax_g.transAxes)

    # Controls
    for i, ctrl in enumerate(controls):
        y = y_start - (row + 0.3) * y_step
        enf = ctrl['enforcement']
        enf_color = {'automated': '#2171b5', 'policy-based': '#d94801',
                     'manual': '#cb181d', 'scheduled': '#238b45'}.get(enf, '#888')

        # Control badge
        badge_text = f"  {ctrl['control_type']}  ({ctrl['tool']})"
        ax_g.text(0.18, y, badge_text,
                  fontsize=6.5, color='#333333', va='top',
                  transform=ax_g.transAxes,
                  bbox=dict(boxstyle='round,pad=0.15', facecolor=gov_layer_colors.get(layer, '#f5f5f5'),
                           edgecolor=enf_color, linewidth=0.8, alpha=0.8))

        # Enforcement tag
        ax_g.text(0.97, y, enf.upper(), fontsize=5.5, fontweight='bold',
                  color=enf_color, va='top', ha='right',
                  transform=ax_g.transAxes)

        row += 0.65

    row += 0.5

# ============================================================
# SAVE
# ============================================================
plt.savefig('/app/output/result.png', dpi=150, bbox_inches='tight',
            facecolor=fig.get_facecolor(), edgecolor='none')
plt.close()
print("Chart saved to /app/output/result.png")

import matplotlib.ticker as mticker

        ax.text(xc, yc + 0.08, label, ha='center', va='center',

leg = ax.legend(handles=legend_elements, loc='upper left', fontsize=8,

                    'con_data_api', 'con_reverse_etl'],
}

node_spacing = {'source': 1.6, 'ingestion': 2.8, 'bronze': 2.0,
                'silver': 2.0, 'gold': 2.0, 'consumption': 1.8}
for layer in layers:
    ordered = node_order[layer]
    n = len(ordered)
    sp = node_spacing[layer]
    total = (n - 1) * sp
    for i, nid in enumerate(ordered):
        node_y[nid] = total / 2 - i * sp

# ============================================================
# FIGURE SETUP
# ============================================================
plt.rcParams.update({
    'font.family': 'sans-serif',
    'font.size': 9,
    'axes.titlesize': 13,
    'axes.titleweight': 'bold',
    'axes.labelsize': 10,
    'figure.facecolor': '#fafafa',
})

fig = plt.figure(figsize=(24, 16), facecolor='#fafafa', dpi=150)
gs = gridspec.GridSpec(2, 2, height_ratios=[3.5, 1], width_ratios=[1.2, 1],
                       hspace=0.22, wspace=0.15,
                       left=0.04, right=0.96, top=0.92, bottom=0.05)

ax_flow = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, :])
ax_trans = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 0])
ax_gov = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 1])

# ============================================================
# MAIN FLOW DIAGRAM
# ============================================================
ax = ax_flow
ax.set_xlim(-2.5, 22.5)
y_min = min(node_y.values()) - 2
y_max = max(node_y.values()) + 2
ax.set_ylim(y_min - 1, y_max + 2.5)
ax.set_aspect('auto')
ax.axis('off')

# Title
fig.suptitle('Data Lakehouse Architecture: End-to-End Pipeline Flow',
             fontsize=20, fontweight='bold', color='#1a1a2e', y=0.97)
ax.set_title('Volume-weighted data flow from 5 source categories through medallion layers to consumption endpoints',
             fontsize=11, color='#555555', pad=15, style='italic')

# Draw layer background bands
band_width = 3.2
for layer in layers:
    xc = x_pos[layer]
    rect = mpatches.FancyBboxPatch(
        (xc - band_width/2, y_min - 0.5), band_width, y_max - y_min + 1.5,
        boxstyle="round,pad=0.3", facecolor=layer_bgs[layer], edgecolor='#cccccc',
        linewidth=0.8, alpha=0.6, zorder=0)
    ax.add_patch(rect)
    # Layer label at top
    ax.text(xc, y_max + 1.8, layer_labels[layers.index(layer)],
            ha='center', va='center', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold',
            color=layer_fills[layer], zorder=5)

# Draw connections (behind nodes)
max_vol = max(e['volume_gb'] for e in edges_data if e['volume_gb'] is not None)

for edge in edges_data:
    src_id = edge['source']
    tgt_id = edge['target']
    if src_id not in node_y or tgt_id not in node_y:
        continue

    x1 = x_pos[node_map[src_id]['layer']] + 0.8
    y1 = node_y[src_id]
    x2 = x_pos[node_map[tgt_id]['layer']] - 0.8
    y2 = node_y[tgt_id]

    vol = edge['volume_gb']
    eid = edge['edge_id']

    # Determine color
    if eid in edge_cat:
        color = cat_colors[edge_cat[eid]]
        alpha = 0.35
    else:
        # Gold → Consumption: use lighter layer-based color
        src_layer = node_map[src_id]['layer']
        color = layer_fills.get(src_layer, '#888888')
        alpha = 0.25

    # Line width proportional to volume
    if vol and vol > 0:
        lw = 1.0 + 6.0 * (vol / max_vol)
    else:
        lw = 0.8
        alpha = 0.2

    # Draw cubic bezier
    mid_x = (x1 + x2) / 2
    verts = [(x1, y1), (mid_x, y1), (mid_x, y2), (x2, y2)]
    codes = [Path.MOVETO, Path.CURVE4, Path.CURVE4, Path.CURVE4]
    path = Path(verts, codes)
    patch = mpatches.PathPatch(path, facecolor='none', edgecolor=color,
                                lw=lw, alpha=alpha, capstyle='round', zorder=1)
    ax.add_patch(patch)

# Draw nodes
for layer in layers:
    for nid in node_order[layer]:
        n = node_map[nid]
        xc = x_pos[layer]
        yc = node_y[nid]
        vol = n['daily_volume_gb']
        label = n['label']

        # Node box
        box_w = 1.5
        box_h = 0.65
        fill = layer_fills[layer]

        # For source nodes, color by category
        if layer == 'source':
            fill = cat_colors.get(n['category'], layer_fills[layer])

        rect = mpatches.FancyBboxPatch(
            (xc - box_w/2, yc - box_h/2), box_w, box_h,
            boxstyle="round,pad=0.12", facecolor=fill, edgecolor='white',
            linewidth=1.5, alpha=0.9, zorder=3)
        ax.add_patch(rect)

        # Label text
        text_color = 'white' if layer in ('bronze', 'silver', 'source', 'ingestion') else '#1a1a2e'
        if layer == 'source':
            text_color = 'white'
        ax.text(xc, yc + 0.08, label, ha='center', va='center',
                fontsize=7, fontweight='bold', color=text_color, zorder=4,
                wrap=True)

        # Volume label
        if vol is not None:
            ax.text(xc, yc - 0.28, f'{vol} GB/d', ha='center', va='center',
                    fontsize=5.5, color=text_color, alpha=0.85, zorder=4)

# Source category legend
legend_elements = [mpatches.Patch(facecolor=cat_colors[c], edgecolor='white', label=c)
                   for c in cat_colors]
leg = ax.legend(handles=legend_elements, loc='upper left', fontsize=8,
                title='Source Categories', title_fontsize=9, frameon=True,
                fancybox=True, framealpha=0.9, edgecolor='#cccccc',
                bbox_to_anchor=(-0.01, 1.0))
leg.get_title().set_fontweight('bold')

# Volume flow annotation
ax.text(22.3, y_max + 1.8, 'Line width ∝ data volume', ha='right', va='center',
        fontsize=8, color='#777777', style='italic')

# ============================================================
# TRANSFORMATION SUMMARY (bottom-left)
# ============================================================
ax_t = ax_trans
ax_t.set_facecolor('#fafafa')

# Prepare data
trans_by_layer = {}
for t in transform_data:
    layer = t['layer']
    if layer not in trans_by_layer:
        trans_by_layer[layer] = {'types': [], 'counts': [], 'complexities': []}
    trans_by_layer[layer]['types'].append(t['transformation_type'])
    trans_by_layer[layer]['counts'].append(t['count'])
    trans_by_layer[layer]['complexities'].append(t['complexity'])

complexity_colors = {'low': '#4292c6', 'medium': '#fdae6b', 'high': '#e6550d'}
medallion_colors = {'bronze': '#b8651a', 'silver': '#6b7b8d', 'gold': '#c9960c'}

# Create grouped horizontal bar chart
all_types = []
all_counts = []
all_layers = []
all_colors = []
y_positions = []
y_idx = 0

layer_positions = {}
for layer in ['bronze', 'silver', 'gold']:
    td = trans_by_layer[layer]
    layer_start = y_idx
    for i in range(len(td['types'])):
        all_types.append(td['types'][i])
        all_counts.append(td['counts'][i])
        all_layers.append(layer)
        all_colors.append(complexity_colors[td['complexities'][i]])
        y_positions.append(y_idx)
        y_idx += 1
    layer_positions[layer] = (layer_start, y_idx - 1)
    y_idx += 0.5  # gap between layers

bars = ax_t.barh(y_positions, all_counts, color=all_colors, edgecolor='white',

# Add value labels
for bar, count in zip(bars, all_counts):
    w = bar.get_width()
    ax_t.text(w + 0.3, bar.get_y() + bar.get_height()/2,
              f'{count}', ha='left', va='center', fontsize=7, fontweight='bold', color='#333333')

ax_t.set_yticks(y_positions)
short_labels = []
for t in all_types:
    # Abbreviate long labels
    sl = t.replace('Schema Conformance (SCD2)', 'SCD2 Conformance').replace('Schema-on-Read Registration', 'Schema-on-Read').replace('Null/Outlier Cleansing', 'Null/Outlier Cleansing').replace('PII Masking / Tokenization', 'PII Masking/Tokenization').replace('Business Logic / KPI Calc', 'Business Logic/KPI Calc')
    short_labels.append(sl)
ax_t.set_yticklabels(short_labels, fontsize=7)
ax_t.invert_yaxis()
ax_t.set_xlabel('Transformation Count', fontsize=9)
ax_t.set_title('Transformation Stages by Medallion Layer', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold', color='#1a1a2e')

# Add layer group labels
for layer, (start, end) in layer_positions.items():
    mid = (start + end) / 2
    ax_t.text(-0.5, mid, layer.upper(), ha='right', va='center',

              transform=ax_t.get_yaxis_transform())

comp_patches = [mpatches.Patch(facecolor=complexity_colors[c], label=f'{c.capitalize()} complexity')

ax_t.legend(handles=comp_patches, loc='lower right', fontsize=7, frameon=True,
            fancybox=True, framealpha=0.9, edgecolor='#cccccc')

ax_t.spines['top'].set_visible(False)
ax_t.spines['right'].set_visible(False)
ax_t.set_xlim(0, max(all_counts) + 3)

ax_g.set_facecolor('#fafafa')
ax_g.axis('off')

for g in governance_data:

    if l not in gov_by_layer:

}
enforcement_icons = {

    'manual': '👤',

y_start = 0.95
y_step = 0.055
row = 0

        continue
    controls = gov_by_layer[layer]

    # Layer label
    ax_g.text(0.02, y_start - row * y_step, gov_layer_labels[layer],

    'e10': 'Enterprise Apps',
    'e11': 'IoT/Streaming', 'e12': 'Logs/Clickstream',
    'e13': 'Enterprise Apps', 'e14': 'External/3rd Party', 'e15': 'Databases',
    'e16': 'External/3rd Party',
    'e17': 'IoT/Streaming', 'e18': 'Enterprise Apps',
    'e19': 'Logs/Clickstream', 'e20': 'Enterprise Apps', 'e21': 'Databases',

# ============================================================

    'bronze': ['brz_raw_iot', 'brz_raw_logs', 'brz_raw_ext', 'brz_raw_txn', 'brz_raw_db'],
    'silver': ['slv_cleaned_iot', 'slv_sessionized_clicks', 'slv_normalized_market',
               'slv_enriched_txn', 'slv_unified_customer'],
    'gold': ['gld_anomaly_features', 'gld_revenue_agg', 'gld_product_perf',
             'gld_marketing_attr', 'gld_customer_ltv'],
    'consumption': ['con_dashboard', 'con_adhoc', 'con_ml_train', 'con_ml_serve',
                    'con_data_api', 'con_reverse_etl'],
}

# X positions for each layer
x_pos = {'source': 0, 'ingestion': 5, 'bronze': 10, 'silver': 15, 'gold': 20, 'consumption': 25}

# Compute Y positions - use different spacing per layer

    boxstyle="round,pad=0.2", facecolor='#f3e5f5', edgecolor='#9c27b0',
    linewidth=1.5, alpha=0.35, zorder=0, linestyle='--')

ax.text(12.5, gov_strip_y - gov_strip_h/2,
        'CROSS-LAYER GOVERNANCE:  End-to-End Lineage (OpenLineage+Purview)  |  Data Classification Tags (Unity Catalog)  |  Compliance Reporting (GDPR/CCPA)',

# ---- Draw connections ----

for edge in sorted_edges:

        ax.text(xc, yc + 0.1, display_label, ha='center', va='center',

# ---- Add transformation count badges on medallion layers ----

    'gold': '#fdf5d6',
    'consumption': '#d5f5d5',
}

# Edge source category mapping
edge_cat = {
    'e01': 'IoT/Streaming', 'e02': 'Enterprise Apps', 'e03': 'Enterprise Apps',
    'e04': 'Logs/Clickstream', 'e05': 'Logs/Clickstream', 'e06': 'External/3rd Party',
    'e07': 'External/3rd Party', 'e08': 'Databases', 'e09': 'Databases',
    'e10': 'Enterprise Apps',
    'e11': 'IoT/Streaming', 'e12': 'Logs/Clickstream',
    'e13': 'Enterprise Apps', 'e14': 'External/3rd Party', 'e15': 'Databases',
    'e16': 'External/3rd Party',
    'e17': 'IoT/Streaming', 'e18': 'Enterprise Apps',
    'e19': 'Logs/Clickstream', 'e20': 'Enterprise Apps', 'e21': 'Databases',
    'e22': 'External/3rd Party',
    'e23': 'Enterprise Apps', 'e24': 'Databases',
    'e25': 'IoT/Streaming', 'e26': 'Enterprise Apps', 'e27': 'Logs/Clickstream',
}

# Governance enforcement colors
enf_colors = {
    'automated': '#2171b5',
    'policy-based': '#d94801',
    'manual': '#cb181d',
    'scheduled': '#238b45',
}

# ============================================================
# NODE POSITIONING
# ============================================================
node_order = {
    'source': ['src_iot', 'src_logs', 'src_clickstream', 'src_erp', 'src_crm',
               'src_files', 'src_social', 'src_market', 'src_rdbms', 'src_nosql'],
    'ingestion': ['ing_stream', 'ing_batch', 'ing_cdc'],
    'bronze': ['brz_raw_iot', 'brz_raw_logs', 'brz_raw_ext', 'brz_raw_txn', 'brz_raw_db'],
    'silver': ['slv_cleaned_iot', 'slv_sessionized_clicks', 'slv_normalized_market',
               'slv_enriched_txn', 'slv_unified_customer'],
    'gold': ['gld_anomaly_features', 'gld_revenue_agg', 'gld_product_perf',
             'gld_marketing_attr', 'gld_customer_ltv'],
    'consumption': ['con_dashboard', 'con_adhoc', 'con_ml_train', 'con_ml_serve',
                    'con_data_api', 'con_reverse_etl'],
}

# X positions for each layer
x_pos = {'source': 0, 'ingestion': 5, 'bronze': 10, 'silver': 15, 'gold': 20, 'consumption': 25}

# Compute Y positions - use different spacing per layer
node_spacing = {'source': 2.0, 'ingestion': 3.5, 'bronze': 2.5,
                'silver': 2.5, 'gold': 2.5, 'consumption': 2.2}

node_y = {}
for layer in layers:
    ordered = node_order[layer]
    n = len(ordered)
    sp = node_spacing[layer]
    total = (n - 1) * sp
    for i, nid in enumerate(ordered):
        node_y[nid] = total / 2 - i * sp

# ============================================================
# FIGURE SETUP
# ============================================================
plt.rcParams.update({
    'font.family': 'DejaVu Sans',
    'font.size': 9,
    'figure.facecolor': '#fafafa',
})

fig = plt.figure(figsize=(26, 18), facecolor='#fafafa', dpi=150)
gs = gridspec.GridSpec(2, 2, height_ratios=[3.2, 1], width_ratios=[1.3, 1],
                       hspace=0.20, wspace=0.12,
                       left=0.03, right=0.97, top=0.93, bottom=0.04)

ax_flow = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, :])
ax_trans = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 0])
ax_gov = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 1])

# ============================================================
# MAIN FLOW DIAGRAM
# ============================================================
ax = ax_flow

y_min = min(node_y.values()) - 2.5
y_max = max(node_y.values()) + 2.5
ax.set_xlim(-3, 28)
ax.set_ylim(y_min - 1, y_max + 4)
ax.set_aspect('auto')
ax.axis('off')

# Title
fig.suptitle('Data Lakehouse Architecture: End-to-End Pipeline Data Flow',
             fontsize=22, fontweight='bold', color='#1a1a2e', y=0.97)
ax.text(12.5, y_max + 3.2,
        'Volume-weighted flow from 5 source categories through medallion layers (Bronze > Silver > Gold) to BI & ML consumption',
        ha='center', va='center', fontsize=11, color='#555555', style='italic')

# ---- Draw layer background bands ----
band_w = 3.8
for layer in layers:
    xc = x_pos[layer]
    rect = mpatches.FancyBboxPatch(
        (xc - band_w/2, y_min - 0.5), band_w, y_max - y_min + 1.0,
        boxstyle="round,pad=0.4", facecolor=layer_bgs[layer], edgecolor='#bbbbbb',
        linewidth=1.0, alpha=0.5, zorder=0)
    ax.add_patch(rect)

    # Layer label at top
    ax.text(xc, y_max + 1.5, layer_labels[layers.index(layer)],
            ha='center', va='center', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold',
            color=layer_fills[layer], zorder=5)

# ---- Draw cross-cutting governance strip ----
gov_strip_y = y_min - 0.2
gov_strip_h = 1.2
rect = mpatches.FancyBboxPatch(
    (-2.5, gov_strip_y - gov_strip_h), 30, gov_strip_h,
    boxstyle="round,pad=0.2", facecolor='#f3e5f5', edgecolor='#9c27b0',
    linewidth=1.5, alpha=0.35, zorder=0, linestyle='--')
ax.add_patch(rect)
ax.text(12.5, gov_strip_y - gov_strip_h/2,
        'CROSS-LAYER GOVERNANCE:  End-to-End Lineage (OpenLineage+Purview)  |  Data Classification Tags (Unity Catalog)  |  Compliance Reporting (GDPR/CCPA)',
        ha='center', va='center', fontsize=8, fontweight='bold', color='#6a1b9a',
        alpha=0.9, zorder=5)

# ---- Draw layer-specific governance badges ----
gov_by_layer = {}
for g in governance_data:
    l = g['layer']
    if l not in gov_by_layer:
        gov_by_layer[l] = []
    gov_by_layer[l].append(g)

for layer in layers:
    if layer not in gov_by_layer:
        continue
    controls = gov_by_layer[layer]
    xc = x_pos[layer]
    # Place small governance badges at bottom of each layer band
    for i, ctrl in enumerate(controls):
        badge_y = y_min + 0.3 + i * 0.55
        enf = ctrl['enforcement']
        badge_color = enf_colors.get(enf, '#888')

        rect = mpatches.FancyBboxPatch(
            (xc - band_w/2 + 0.15, badge_y - 0.2), band_w - 0.3, 0.4,
            boxstyle="round,pad=0.08", facecolor='white', edgecolor=badge_color,
            linewidth=0.8, alpha=0.75, zorder=6)
        ax.add_patch(rect)
        ax.text(xc, badge_y, f"{ctrl['control_type']}",
                ha='center', va='center', fontsize=4.8, color='#333',
                fontweight='bold', zorder=7)

# ---- Draw connections ----
max_vol = max(e['volume_gb'] for e in edges_data if e['volume_gb'] is not None)

# Sort edges so high-volume ones are drawn first (behind)
sorted_edges = sorted(edges_data, key=lambda e: -(e['volume_gb'] or 0))

for edge in sorted_edges:
    src_id = edge['source']
    tgt_id = edge['target']
    if src_id not in node_y or tgt_id not in node_y:
        continue

    src_layer = node_map[src_id]['layer']
    tgt_layer = node_map[tgt_id]['layer']
    x1 = x_pos[src_layer] + 1.4
    y1 = node_y[src_id]
    x2 = x_pos[tgt_layer] - 1.4
    y2 = node_y[tgt_id]

    vol = edge['volume_gb']
    eid = edge['edge_id']

    # Determine color based on source category
    if eid in edge_cat:
        color = cat_colors[edge_cat[eid]]
        alpha = 0.4 if vol and vol > 100 else 0.3
    else:
        color = layer_fills.get(src_layer, '#888888')
        alpha = 0.2

    # Line width proportional to volume
    if vol and vol > 0:
        lw = 1.5 + 7.0 * (vol / max_vol)
    else:
        lw = 1.0
        alpha = 0.15
        color = '#888888'

    # Draw cubic bezier
    mid_x = (x1 + x2) / 2
    verts = [(x1, y1), (mid_x, y1), (mid_x, y2), (x2, y2)]
    codes = [Path.MOVETO, Path.CURVE4, Path.CURVE4, Path.CURVE4]
    path = Path(verts, codes)
    patch = mpatches.PathPatch(path, facecolor='none', edgecolor=color,
                                lw=lw, alpha=alpha, capstyle='round', zorder=1)
    ax.add_patch(patch)

    # Volume label on high-volume connections
    if vol and vol >= 100:
        mid_y = (y1 + y2) / 2
        ax.text(mid_x, mid_y, f'{vol} GB',
                ha='center', va='center', fontsize=6, fontweight='bold',
                color=color, alpha=0.7,
                bbox=dict(boxstyle='round,pad=0.12', facecolor='white',
                         edgecolor='none', alpha=0.7),
                zorder=2)

# ---- Draw nodes ----
box_w = 2.4
box_h = 0.75

for layer in layers:
    for nid in node_order[layer]:
        n = node_map[nid]
        xc = x_pos[layer]
        yc = node_y[nid]
        vol = n['daily_volume_gb']
        label = n['label']

        # Node fill color
        if layer == 'source':
            fill = cat_colors.get(n['category'], layer_fills[layer])
        else:
            fill = layer_fills[layer]

        # Draw node box
        rect = mpatches.FancyBboxPatch(
            (xc - box_w/2, yc - box_h/2), box_w, box_h,
            boxstyle="round,pad=0.15", facecolor=fill, edgecolor='white',
            linewidth=2, alpha=0.92, zorder=3)
        ax.add_patch(rect)

        # Label text
        text_color = 'white'
        if layer == 'gold':
            text_color = '#1a1a2e'

        # Truncate long labels
        display_label = label
        if len(display_label) > 20:
            display_label = display_label[:18] + '...'

        ax.text(xc, yc + 0.1, display_label, ha='center', va='center',
                fontsize=7.5, fontweight='bold', color=text_color, zorder=4)

        # Volume label
        if vol is not None:
            vol_str = f'{vol:,} GB/day'
            ax.text(xc, yc - 0.22, vol_str, ha='center', va='center',
                    fontsize=5.5, color=text_color, alpha=0.85, zorder=4)

# ---- Add transformation count badges on medallion layers ----
trans_by_layer = {}
for t in transform_data:
    l = t['layer']
    if l not in trans_by_layer:
        trans_by_layer[l] = {'total': 0, 'types': []}
    trans_by_layer[l]['total'] += t['count']
    trans_by_layer[l]['types'].append(t['transformation_type'])

for layer in ['bronze', 'silver', 'gold']:
    if layer in trans_by_layer:
        total = trans_by_layer[layer]['total']
        xc = x_pos[layer]
        # Place badge above the top node
        top_y = node_y[node_order[layer][0]] + 1.5

        badge = mpatches.FancyBboxPatch(
            (xc - 1.1, top_y - 0.25), 2.2, 0.5,
            boxstyle="round,pad=0.1", facecolor=layer_fills[layer],
            edgecolor='white', linewidth=1.5, alpha=0.85, zorder=5)
        ax.add_patch(badge)
        ax.text(xc, top_y, f'{total} transforms',
                ha='center', va='center', fontsize=7, fontweight='bold',
                color='white' if layer != 'gold' else '#1a1a2e', zorder=6)

# ---- Source category legend ----
legend_elements = [mpatches.Patch(facecolor=cat_colors[c], edgecolor='white',
                                   label=f'{c} ({sum(1 for n in nodes_data if n["category"]==c and n["layer"]=="source")} sources)')
                   for c in cat_colors]
leg = ax.legend(handles=legend_elements, loc='upper left', fontsize=8,
                title='Source Categories', title_fontsize=9, frameon=True,
                fancybox=True, framealpha=0.92, edgecolor='#cccccc',
                bbox_to_anchor=(0.0, 1.02))
leg.get_title().set_fontweight('bold')

# Flow direction arrow
ax.annotate('', xy=(27, y_max + 1.5), xytext=(-2.5, y_max + 1.5),
            arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='->', color='#999999', lw=1.5))
ax.text(12.5, y_max + 2.3, 'DATA FLOW DIRECTION', ha='center', va='center',
        fontsize=7, color='#999999', fontweight='bold', letterspace=0.1)

# ============================================================
# TRANSFORMATION SUMMARY (bottom-left)
# ============================================================
ax_t = ax_trans
ax_t.set_facecolor('#fafafa')

complexity_colors = {'low': '#6baed6', 'medium': '#fd8d3c', 'high': '#e6550d'}
medallion_colors = {'bronze': '#a0612b', 'silver': '#5f6b7a', 'gold': '#b8860b'}

all_types = []
all_counts = []
all_layers_list = []
all_colors = []
y_positions = []
y_idx = 0
layer_positions = {}

for layer in ['bronze', 'silver', 'gold']:
    td = trans_by_layer.get(layer, {'types': [], 'total': 0})
    layer_start = y_idx
    for i, t_type in enumerate(td['types']):
        # Find the matching transformation record
        rec = next(r for r in transform_data if r['layer'] == layer and r['transformation_type'] == t_type)
        all_types.append(t_type)
        all_counts.append(rec['count'])
        all_layers_list.append(layer)
        all_colors.append(complexity_colors[rec['complexity']])
        y_positions.append(y_idx)
        y_idx += 1
    layer_positions[layer] = (layer_start, y_idx - 1)
    y_idx += 0.8

bars = ax_t.barh(y_positions, all_counts, color=all_colors, edgecolor='white',
                  height=0.7, alpha=0.85, zorder=2)

for bar, count in zip(bars, all_counts):
    w = bar.get_width()
    ax_t.text(w + 0.3, bar.get_y() + bar.get_height()/2,
              f'{count}', ha='left', va='center', fontsize=7, fontweight='bold', color='#333')

short_map = {
    'Schema-on-Read Registration': 'Schema-on-Read',
    'Deduplication (Append-Only)': 'Deduplication',
    'Timestamp Normalization': 'Timestamp Norm.',
    'Null/Outlier Cleansing': 'Null/Outlier Cleanse',
    'Schema Conformance (SCD2)': 'SCD2 Conformance',
    'Join / Enrichment': 'Join/Enrichment',
    'Sessionization': 'Sessionization',
    'PII Masking / Tokenization': 'PII Mask/Tokenize',
    'Aggregation / Roll-up': 'Aggregation/Roll-up',
    'Feature Engineering': 'Feature Engineering',
    'Business Logic / KPI Calc': 'Business Logic/KPI',
    'Materialized Views': 'Materialized Views',
}
short_labels = [short_map.get(t, t) for t in all_types]

ax_t.set_yticks(y_positions)
ax_t.set_yticklabels(short_labels, fontsize=7)
ax_t.invert_yaxis()
ax_t.set_xlabel('Transformation Count', fontsize=9)
ax_t.set_title('Transformations by Medallion Layer & Complexity', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold', color='#1a1a2e')

for layer, (start, end) in layer_positions.items():
    mid = (start + end) / 2
    ax_t.text(-0.3, mid, layer.upper(), ha='right', va='center',
              fontsize=9, fontweight='bold', color=medallion_colors[layer],
              transform=ax_t.get_yaxis_transform())

comp_patches = [mpatches.Patch(facecolor=complexity_colors[c], label=f'{c.capitalize()} complexity')
                for c in ['low', 'medium', 'high']]
ax_t.legend(handles=comp_patches, loc='lower right', fontsize=7, frameon=True,
            fancybox=True, framealpha=0.9, edgecolor='#cccccc')
ax_t.spines['top'].set_visible(False)
ax_t.spines['right'].set_visible(False)
ax_t.set_xlim(0, max(all_counts) + 3)

# ============================================================
# GOVERNANCE CONTROLS (bottom-right)
# ============================================================
ax_g = ax_gov
ax_g.set_facecolor('#fafafa')
ax_g.axis('off')
ax_g.set_title('Governance Controls by Pipeline Stage', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold', color='#1a1a2e')

gov_layer_order = ['ingestion', 'bronze', 'silver', 'gold', 'consumption', 'cross-layer']
gov_layer_labels = {
    'ingestion': 'INGESTION', 'bronze': 'BRONZE', 'silver': 'SILVER',
    'gold': 'GOLD', 'consumption': 'CONSUMPTION', 'cross-layer': 'CROSS-LAYER'
}
gov_layer_colors_bg = {
    'ingestion': '#fdd0a2', 'bronze': '#f5e0cc', 'silver': '#e0e3e7',
    'gold': '#fdf5d6', 'consumption': '#d4edda', 'cross-layer': '#e8daef'
}

y_start = 0.96
y_step = 0.062
row = 0

for layer in gov_layer_order:
    if layer not in gov_by_layer:
        continue
    controls = gov_by_layer[layer]

    # Layer header
    header_y = y_start - row * y_step
    ax_g.text(0.02, header_y, gov_layer_labels[layer],
              fontsize=8.5, fontweight='bold', color=layer_fills.get(layer, '#333'),
              va='top', transform=ax_g.transAxes)
    # Layer color bar
    ax_g.add_patch(mpatches.FancyBboxPatch(
        (0.0, header_y - 0.02), 1.0, 0.025,
        boxstyle="round,pad=0.005", facecolor=gov_layer_colors_bg.get(layer, '#f5f5f5'),
        edgecolor='none', alpha=0.5, transform=ax_g.transAxes, zorder=0))

    row += 0.5

    for ctrl in controls:
        y = y_start - row * y_step
        enf = ctrl['enforcement']
        enf_color = enf_colors.get(enf, '#888')

        # Control badge
        badge_text = f"{ctrl['control_type']}  [{ctrl['tool']}]"
        ax_g.text(0.04, y, badge_text,
                  fontsize=6.5, color='#333333', va='top',
                  transform=ax_g.transAxes,
                  bbox=dict(boxstyle='round,pad=0.15', facecolor=gov_layer_colors_bg.get(layer, '#f5f5f5'),
                           edgecolor=enf_color, linewidth=1.0, alpha=0.85))

        # Enforcement tag
        ax_g.text(0.98, y, enf.upper(), fontsize=5.5, fontweight='bold',
                  color=enf_color, va='top', ha='right',
                  transform=ax_g.transAxes)

        row += 0.7

    row += 0.3

# Enforcement legend
enf_patches = [mpatches.Patch(facecolor=enf_colors[e], label=f'{e.capitalize()}')
               for e in ['automated', 'policy-based', 'manual', 'scheduled']]
ax_g.legend(handles=enf_patches, loc='lower right', fontsize=6.5, frameon=True,
            fancybox=True, framealpha=0.9, edgecolor='#cccccc', title='Enforcement',
            title_fontsize=7)

# ============================================================
# SAVE
# ============================================================
plt.savefig('/app/output/result.png', dpi=150, bbox_inches='tight',
            facecolor=fig.get_facecolor(), edgecolor='none')
plt.close()
print("Chart saved to /app/output/result.png")

matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import matplotlib.patches as mpatches
from matplotlib.path import Path
import matplotlib.gridspec as gridspec
import numpy as np
import json

# ============================================================
# LOAD DATA
# ============================================================
with open('/app/benchmark/source_data.json') as f:
    data = json.load(f)

nodes_data = data['architecture_nodes']['data']
edges_data = data['architecture_edges']['data']
governance_data = data['governance_controls']['data']
transform_data = data['transformation_summary']['data']

node_map = {n['node_id']: n for n in nodes_data}

# ============================================================
# CONFIGURATION
# ============================================================
layers = ['source', 'ingestion', 'bronze', 'silver', 'gold', 'consumption']
layer_labels = ['Data Sources', 'Ingestion', 'Bronze (Raw)', 'Silver (Curated)', 'Gold (Business)', 'Consumption']

# Source category colors (colorblind-friendly)
cat_colors = {
    'IoT/Streaming': '#2171b5',
    'Enterprise Apps': '#d94801',
    'Logs/Clickstream': '#cb181d',
    'External/3rd Party': '#238b45',
    'Databases': '#6a51a3',
}

# Layer node colors

    'source': '#3182bd',

}

edge_cat = {
    'e01': 'IoT/Streaming', 'e02': 'Enterprise Apps', 'e03': 'Enterprise Apps',
    'e04': 'Logs/Clickstream', 'e05': 'Logs/Clickstream', 'e06': 'External/3rd Party',
    'e07': 'External/3rd Party', 'e08': 'Databases', 'e09': 'Databases',
    'e10': 'Enterprise Apps',
    'e11': 'IoT/Streaming', 'e12': 'Logs/Clickstream',
    'e13': 'Enterprise Apps', 'e14': 'External/3rd Party', 'e15': 'Databases',
    'e16': 'External/3rd Party',
    'e17': 'IoT/Streaming', 'e18': 'Enterprise Apps',
    'e19': 'Logs/Clickstream', 'e20': 'Enterprise Apps', 'e21': 'Databases',
    'e22': 'External/3rd Party',
    'e23': 'Enterprise Apps', 'e24': 'Databases',
    'e25': 'IoT/Streaming', 'e26': 'Enterprise Apps', 'e27': 'Logs/Clickstream',
}

# Governance enforcement colors
enf_colors = {
    'automated': '#2171b5',
    'policy-based': '#d94801',
    'manual': '#cb181d',
    'scheduled': '#238b45',
}

# ============================================================
# NODE POSITIONING
# ============================================================
node_order = {
    'source': ['src_iot', 'src_logs', 'src_clickstream', 'src_erp', 'src_crm',
               'src_files', 'src_social', 'src_market', 'src_rdbms', 'src_nosql'],
    'ingestion': ['ing_stream', 'ing_batch', 'ing_cdc'],
    'bronze': ['brz_raw_iot', 'brz_raw_logs', 'brz_raw_ext', 'brz_raw_txn', 'brz_raw_db'],
    'silver': ['slv_cleaned_iot', 'slv_sessionized_clicks', 'slv_normalized_market',
               'slv_enriched_txn', 'slv_unified_customer'],
    'gold': ['gld_anomaly_features', 'gld_revenue_agg', 'gld_product_perf',
             'gld_marketing_attr', 'gld_customer_ltv'],
    'consumption': ['con_dashboard', 'con_adhoc', 'con_ml_train', 'con_ml_serve',
                    'con_data_api', 'con_reverse_etl'],
}

# X positions for each layer
x_pos = {'source': 0, 'ingestion': 5, 'bronze': 10, 'silver': 15, 'gold': 20, 'consumption': 25}

# Compute Y positions - use different spacing per layer
node_spacing = {'source': 2.0, 'ingestion': 3.5, 'bronze': 2.5,
                'silver': 2.5, 'gold': 2.5, 'consumption': 2.2}

node_y = {}
for layer in layers:
    ordered = node_order[layer]
    n = len(ordered)
    sp = node_spacing[layer]
    total = (n - 1) * sp
    for i, nid in enumerate(ordered):
        node_y[nid] = total / 2 - i * sp

# ============================================================

# ============================================================
plt.rcParams.update({
    'font.family': 'DejaVu Sans',
    'font.size': 9,
    'figure.facecolor': '#fafafa',
})

fig = plt.figure(figsize=(26, 18), facecolor='#fafafa', dpi=150)
gs = gridspec.GridSpec(2, 2, height_ratios=[3.2, 1], width_ratios=[1.3, 1],
                       hspace=0.20, wspace=0.12,
                       left=0.03, right=0.97, top=0.93, bottom=0.04)

ax_flow = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, :])
ax_trans = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 0])
ax_gov = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 1])

# ============================================================
# MAIN FLOW DIAGRAM
# ============================================================
ax = ax_flow

y_min = min(node_y.values()) - 2.5
y_max = max(node_y.values()) + 2.5
ax.set_xlim(-3, 28)
ax.set_ylim(y_min - 1, y_max + 4)
ax.set_aspect('auto')
ax.axis('off')

# Title
fig.suptitle('Data Lakehouse Architecture: End-to-End Pipeline Data Flow',
             fontsize=22, fontweight='bold', color='#1a1a2e', y=0.97)
ax.text(12.5, y_max + 3.2,
        'Volume-weighted flow from 5 source categories through medallion layers (Bronze > Silver > Gold) to BI & ML consumption',
        ha='center', va='center', fontsize=11, color='#555555', style='italic')

# ---- Draw layer background bands ----
band_w = 3.8
for layer in layers:
    xc = x_pos[layer]
    rect = mpatches.FancyBboxPatch(

    ax.add_patch(rect)

    # Layer label at top
    ax.text(xc, y_max + 1.5, layer_labels[layers.index(layer)],

# ---- Draw cross-cutting governance strip ----
gov_strip_y = y_min - 0.2
gov_strip_h = 1.2

# ---- Draw layer-specific governance badges ----

for g in governance_data:

            linewidth=0.8, alpha=0.75, zorder=6)
        ax.add_patch(rect)
        ax.text(xc, badge_y, f"{ctrl['control_type']}",

# ---- Draw connections ----
max_vol = max(e['volume_gb'] for e in edges_data if e['volume_gb'] is not None)

# Sort edges so high-volume ones are drawn first (behind)
sorted_edges = sorted(edges_data, key=lambda e: -(e['volume_gb'] or 0))

for edge in sorted_edges:
    src_id = edge['source']
    tgt_id = edge['target']
    if src_id not in node_y or tgt_id not in node_y:
        continue

    src_layer = node_map[src_id]['layer']
    tgt_layer = node_map[tgt_id]['layer']
    x1 = x_pos[src_layer] + 1.4
    y1 = node_y[src_id]
    x2 = x_pos[tgt_layer] - 1.4
    y2 = node_y[tgt_id]

    vol = edge['volume_gb']
    eid = edge['edge_id']

    # Determine color based on source category
    if eid in edge_cat:
        color = cat_colors[edge_cat[eid]]
        alpha = 0.4 if vol and vol > 100 else 0.3
    else:
        color = layer_fills.get(src_layer, '#888888')
        alpha = 0.2

    # Line width proportional to volume
    if vol and vol > 0:
        lw = 1.5 + 7.0 * (vol / max_vol)
    else:
        lw = 1.0
        alpha = 0.15
        color = '#888888'

    # Draw cubic bezier
    mid_x = (x1 + x2) / 2
    verts = [(x1, y1), (mid_x, y1), (mid_x, y2), (x2, y2)]
    codes = [Path.MOVETO, Path.CURVE4, Path.CURVE4, Path.CURVE4]
    path = Path(verts, codes)
    patch = mpatches.PathPatch(path, facecolor='none', edgecolor=color,
                                lw=lw, alpha=alpha, capstyle='round', zorder=1)
    ax.add_patch(patch)

    # Volume label on high-volume connections
    if vol and vol >= 100:
        mid_y = (y1 + y2) / 2
        ax.text(mid_x, mid_y, f'{vol} GB',
                ha='center', va='center', fontsize=6, fontweight='bold',
                color=color, alpha=0.7,
                bbox=dict(boxstyle='round,pad=0.12', facecolor='white',
                         edgecolor='none', alpha=0.7),
                zorder=2)

# ---- Draw nodes ----
box_w = 2.4
box_h = 0.75

for layer in layers:
    for nid in node_order[layer]:
        n = node_map[nid]
        xc = x_pos[layer]
        yc = node_y[nid]
        vol = n['daily_volume_gb']
        label = n['label']

        # Node fill color
        if layer == 'source':
            fill = cat_colors.get(n['category'], layer_fills[layer])
        else:
            fill = layer_fills[layer]

        # Draw node box
        rect = mpatches.FancyBboxPatch(
            (xc - box_w/2, yc - box_h/2), box_w, box_h,
            boxstyle="round,pad=0.15", facecolor=fill, edgecolor='white',
            linewidth=2, alpha=0.92, zorder=3)
        ax.add_patch(rect)

        # Label text
        text_color = 'white'
        if layer == 'gold':
            text_color = '#1a1a2e'

        # Truncate long labels
        display_label = label
        if len(display_label) > 20:
            display_label = display_label[:18] + '...'

        ax.text(xc, yc + 0.1, display_label, ha='center', va='center',
                fontsize=7.5, fontweight='bold', color=text_color, zorder=4)

        # Volume label
        if vol is not None:
            vol_str = f'{vol:,} GB/day'
            ax.text(xc, yc - 0.22, vol_str, ha='center', va='center',
                    fontsize=5.5, color=text_color, alpha=0.85, zorder=4)

# ---- Add transformation count badges on medallion layers ----
trans_by_layer = {}
for t in transform_data:
    l = t['layer']
    if l not in trans_by_layer:
        trans_by_layer[l] = {'total': 0, 'types': []}
    trans_by_layer[l]['total'] += t['count']
    trans_by_layer[l]['types'].append(t['transformation_type'])

for layer in ['bronze', 'silver', 'gold']:
    if layer in trans_by_layer:
        total = trans_by_layer[layer]['total']
        xc = x_pos[layer]
        # Place badge above the top node
        top_y = node_y[node_order[layer][0]] + 1.5

        badge = mpatches.FancyBboxPatch(
            (xc - 1.1, top_y - 0.25), 2.2, 0.5,
            boxstyle="round,pad=0.1", facecolor=layer_fills[layer],
            edgecolor='white', linewidth=1.5, alpha=0.85, zorder=5)
        ax.add_patch(badge)
        ax.text(xc, top_y, f'{total} transforms',
                ha='center', va='center', fontsize=7, fontweight='bold',
                color='white' if layer != 'gold' else '#1a1a2e', zorder=6)

# ---- Source category legend ----
legend_elements = [mpatches.Patch(facecolor=cat_colors[c], edgecolor='white',
                                   label=f'{c} ({sum(1 for n in nodes_data if n["category"]==c and n["layer"]=="source")} sources)')
                   for c in cat_colors]
leg = ax.legend(handles=legend_elements, loc='upper left', fontsize=8,
                title='Source Categories', title_fontsize=9, frameon=True,
                fancybox=True, framealpha=0.92, edgecolor='#cccccc',
                bbox_to_anchor=(0.0, 1.02))
leg.get_title().set_fontweight('bold')

# Flow direction arrow
ax.annotate('', xy=(27, y_max + 1.5), xytext=(-2.5, y_max + 1.5),
            arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='->', color='#999999', lw=1.5))
ax.text(12.5, y_max + 2.3, 'DATA FLOW DIRECTION', ha='center', va='center',
        fontsize=7, color='#999999', fontweight='bold', letterspace=0.1)

# TRANSFORMATION SUMMARY (bottom-left)
# ============================================================
ax_t = ax_trans
ax_t.set_facecolor('#fafafa')

complexity_colors = {'low': '#6baed6', 'medium': '#fd8d3c', 'high': '#e6550d'}
medallion_colors = {'bronze': '#a0612b', 'silver': '#5f6b7a', 'gold': '#b8860b'}

all_types = []
all_counts = []
all_layers_list = []
all_colors = []
y_positions = []
y_idx = 0
layer_positions = {}

for layer in ['bronze', 'silver', 'gold']:
    td = trans_by_layer.get(layer, {'types': [], 'total': 0})
    layer_start = y_idx
    for i, t_type in enumerate(td['types']):
        # Find the matching transformation record
        rec = next(r for r in transform_data if r['layer'] == layer and r['transformation_type'] == t_type)
        all_types.append(t_type)
        all_counts.append(rec['count'])
        all_layers_list.append(layer)
        all_colors.append(complexity_colors[rec['complexity']])
        y_positions.append(y_idx)
        y_idx += 1
    layer_positions[layer] = (layer_start, y_idx - 1)
    y_idx += 0.8

bars = ax_t.barh(y_positions, all_counts, color=all_colors, edgecolor='white',

for bar, count in zip(bars, all_counts):

    ax_t.text(w + 0.3, bar.get_y() + bar.get_height()/2,

}

ax_t.set_xlabel('Transformation Count', fontsize=9)

gov_layer_colors_bg = {

}

y_start = 0.96
y_step = 0.062
row = 0

for layer in gov_layer_order:
    if layer not in gov_by_layer:
        continue
    controls = gov_by_layer[layer]

    # Layer header
    header_y = y_start - row * y_step
    ax_g.text(0.02, header_y, gov_layer_labels[layer],
              fontsize=8.5, fontweight='bold', color=layer_fills.get(layer, '#333'),
              va='top', transform=ax_g.transAxes)
    # Layer color bar
    ax_g.add_patch(mpatches.FancyBboxPatch(
        (0.0, header_y - 0.02), 1.0, 0.025,
        boxstyle="round,pad=0.005", facecolor=gov_layer_colors_bg.get(layer, '#f5f5f5'),
        edgecolor='none', alpha=0.5, transform=ax_g.transAxes, zorder=0))

    row += 0.5

    for ctrl in controls:
        y = y_start - row * y_step
        enf = ctrl['enforcement']
        enf_color = enf_colors.get(enf, '#888')

        # Control badge
        badge_text = f"{ctrl['control_type']}  [{ctrl['tool']}]"
        ax_g.text(0.04, y, badge_text,
                  fontsize=6.5, color='#333333', va='top',
                  transform=ax_g.transAxes,
                  bbox=dict(boxstyle='round,pad=0.15', facecolor=gov_layer_colors_bg.get(layer, '#f5f5f5'),
                           edgecolor=enf_color, linewidth=1.0, alpha=0.85))

        # Enforcement tag
        ax_g.text(0.98, y, enf.upper(), fontsize=5.5, fontweight='bold',
                  color=enf_color, va='top', ha='right',
                  transform=ax_g.transAxes)

        row += 0.7

    row += 0.3

# Enforcement legend
enf_patches = [mpatches.Patch(facecolor=enf_colors[e], label=f'{e.capitalize()}')
               for e in ['automated', 'policy-based', 'manual', 'scheduled']]
ax_g.legend(handles=enf_patches, loc='lower right', fontsize=6.5, frameon=True,
            fancybox=True, framealpha=0.9, edgecolor='#cccccc', title='Enforcement',
            title_fontsize=7)

# ============================================================
# SAVE
# ============================================================
plt.savefig('/app/output/result.png', dpi=150, bbox_inches='tight',
            facecolor=fig.get_facecolor(), edgecolor='none')
plt.close()
